question: Does linear cubic compensation equality force the selected high graph to contain cycles only, with no path components?
scope: Research answer proving the cubic normal-form augmentation W>=2c and exclusion of paths at linear equality. The arbitrary-bipartite extension and refined debt were derived locally afterward and have a separate review request.
verification: Each extra leaf is isolated in the exchange retaining its color; its unused degree-two witness sees only that leaf there. Added witnesses share a color and have distinct partners. All edge types and size counts independently checked.
result: Every cubic linear-equality selection has high graph a union of even cycles. On every zero-accounting-remainder cubic normal form, W>=2c.
